CustomField.label: Display: Expected Formula
CustomField.description: Optional and display only - it never affects pass/fail. A formula, evaluated on the current record, whose result is shown as the "Expected" value on the result row (the right side of the comparison - what the record should have had). Write fixed values in formula syntax, the same way as "Display: Found Formula". Its return type is set by "Formula Result Type". Leave blank to show the default "Passes when..." line echoing the "Pass Condition".
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Display only (not pass/fail). Formula for the "Expected" value shown on the row. Fixed values use formula syntax. Blank = shows the default "Pass Condition" line.
